name: BIGTIME Token
rootCause: A same-name BIGTIME token on BNB Chain was rug-pulled on PancakeSwap on 2023-10-13, with reported losses of $168,699. The available record points to a backdoored or deployer-controlled BEP20 token contract that let the seller credit their own balance and drain PancakeSwap liquidity. The exact historical function is not independently verified.
